subject: Partner Enablement Field Roadshow — S3 + Vector Store GTM & Incentives
messages: Subject: Partner Enablement Field Roadshow — S3 + Vector Store GTM & Incentives

Hi Alisha —

Thanks again for the intro call last week. We're putting together a short 'field roadshow' for the next quarter to accelerate co-sell with our vector store and object-store partners (Pinecone, Weaviate, and strategic S3 storage partners). The idea is to combine technical enablement, joint benchmarks, and a modest incentive pool for early closed-won opportunities to kick off customer success momentum.

High-level asks from our side: 
- Pinecone: agree to a joint benchmark template (3 customer archetypes), provide a technical SME for two customer workshops, and commit to co-marketing promotion for each closed pilot.
- S3 partners / DataGlue: agree to a pilot for cold-tier fallback for embeddings (S3 as cost-efficient fallthrough), plus one reference implementation we can jointly demo.
- Redwood: we will run the benchmark, provide an evaluation harness, and cover a $12k incentive pool per partner for qualifying deals (proposal attached).

Attachments: roadshow-deck-v1.pdf (agenda + roles), partner-incentive-term-sheet.xlsx (draft).

Can you confirm Pinecone's availability for a steering call next Tuesday (Nov 9) and whether Pinecone's engineering team can support the benchmark tooling?

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Director, Alliances & GTM
Redwood Inference

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference>, Samir Dubey <samir@data-glue.com>
Subject: Re: Partner Enablement Field Roadshow — S3 + Vector Store GTM & Incentives

Soojin — great to see this coming together. We like the structure and can commit an engineering SME for the benchmark and two customer workshops (EMEA and US). A couple of quick notes from Pinecone's side: 

1) Benchmark template: we prefer a 1) retrieval-latency (p99/median) 2) cost-per-query (normalized) 3) accuracy by prompt-family. We can provide a small harness to run against your eval sets (JSON + scripts).
2) Data residency: if any of the targeted customers require EU-only processing, we need to align on which region the benchmark runs in; can you flag any EU prospects?
3) Incentives: Pinecone needs a clear MQL-to-payout definition (we can sign off on a term-sheet if you add minimum contract value and timing).

I'll join the steering call Nov 9 at 10am PT — Vanessa, Marcus, Samir: if you can share the customer archetypes before Monday that will help us size the harness.

Cheers,
Alisha Kapoor
Partnerships, Pinecone
alisha@pinecone.io

Team — notes from the steering call (summary + actions). I captured items we need to finalize before publicizing the roadshow: 

Key decisions: 
- Benchmark scope: agreed to the three KPIs Alisha proposed (latency, cost, accuracy). Marcus will assemble the eval harness and share by EOD Nov 13.
- Incentive structure: we move to a milestone-based payout: 40% on pilot launch (customer signed with pilot MOU), 40% on go-live, 20% on reference (30-day). Marcus, please review the draft term-sheet and add minimum contract value (suggest $25k ARR) — attached.
- EU prospects: Samir flagged a German prospect that needs EU-only processing; we will run the benchmark in eu-west-1 and note regional performance separately. 

Action items: 
- Marcus Lin: finalize harness + run a dry-run with Pinecone by Nov 16. (attachments: pilot-scope-draft.md)
- Soojin: update partner one-pager with tiered incentives and the press plan. Target publish date Nov 20.
- Lauren: coordinate co-marketing assets (case study template, joint webinar playbook).

Attachments included in thread: partner-incentive-term-sheet.xlsx, pilot-scope-draft.md.
